answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a delta spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an oasis header. Producing 38 answers an epoch therefore costs 46 real forward passes, and the lagoon record lets any auditor recompute the check. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
